name: Easy
summary: Weaker enemies, more gold, a longer countdown and a gentler difficulty curve. Good for learning the eras.

name: Normal
summary: The intended challenge. Every stage presses a little harder than the last; you need a mixed defence and cannot afford everything.

name: Hard
summary: Faster, armoured enemies, more elites, special enemies from stage 11, angrier bosses and less gold. For players who know every tower's job.
